description.value:
You're surrounded by thick smoke that is hard to see through.

Visual Perception checks take a circumstance penalty that depends on how thick it is, anything seen through a lot of it is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and you can't see beyond half a mile at most. Close to a wildfire, the smoke and superheated air leave you holding your breath or suffocating.

Basic environmental protection doesn't filter smoke. Under the Enhanced Rules, an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-enhanced-environmental-protection.upgrades.Item.hXd5pHw4Oc0vHC3D]{Advanced Filtered Air Supply} does.
